ruleDefinitions.name: HackTool - Potential CobaltStrike Process Injection
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects a potential remote threat creation with certain characteristics which are typical for Cobalt Strike beacons Note: Unmapped fields: StartAddress

sequences.query: (StartAddress = RGX("0B80$") OR StartAddress = RGX("0C7C$") OR StartAddress = RGX("0C88$"))
